parameters.name: hasOutline
parameters.description: Only return courses with a saved module outline

get.summary: Get presence status for a list of users

200.description: Left the room. roomDeleted indicates if the room was also deleted.

parameters.name: hasSummary
parameters.description: Only return posts that have an AI summary

get.summary: Progress of document indexing for AI chat

200.description: AI response to the user message

post.summary: Chat with a post using AI

roomSlug.description: Room slug — required when purpose is board-attachment, scopes the S3 folder

checksumSha256.description: Base64-encoded SHA-256 of the file body, verified by storage on upload.

password.description: Optional password to protect room on creation

hasPassword.description: Whether room has a password set (never exposes the hash)

encrypted.description: Whether board content is end-to-end encrypted with a key carried in the URL fragment. False for rooms created before this existed.

pwVerified.description: Sentinel from sessionStorage — skip password check if true (D-22)

encrypted.description: Whether board content is end-to-end encrypted (key in URL fragment)

publicKey.description: RSA-OAEP public key in JWK format

keyBackup.description: Passphrase-encrypted private key transfer payload (PBKDF2 + AES-GCM JSON blob). Opaque to the server.

courseId.description: Course ID. Must belong to the authenticated user department.

AiIndexState.description: 'unsupported' — nothing on this post can be indexed. 'preparing' — at least one supported file is still pending or processing. 'ready' — indexing has settled and at least one supported file was indexed. 'failed' — indexing has settled and none succeeded.

state.description: 'unsupported' — nothing on this post can be indexed. 'preparing' — at least one supported file is still pending or processing. 'ready' — indexing has settled and at least one supported file was indexed. 'failed' — indexing has settled and none succeeded.

indexedChunks.description: Live count of post_chunk rows for this post. Deliberately not a percentage: the total chunk count is unknowable until chunking finishes, so any ratio would be invented.

supportedFiles.description: Files on this post whose mime type can be indexed

readyFiles.description: Supported files that finished indexing successfully

pageNum.description: Null for .docx, which has no pages

fileId.description: Which uploaded file this chunk came from

fileName.description: Display name of the file, for attributing the page

snippet.description: Short excerpt of the cited chunk

offTopic.description: True when the question was unrelated to the document

parentId.description: Parent comment ID when creating a nested reply.
Parent comment ID when creating a nested reply.

postId.description: ID of the post to suggest as fulfillment
Post ID with an AI summary to generate quiz from

courseId.description: Course to generate one quiz per outlined module for

queueAheadIsApproximate.description: True when the exact position is beyond the scan limit

hasPdf.description: A PDF render exists, so the deck can be previewed in-app

canEdit.description: The generator can still act on this deck

editorUrl.description: Where to point the editor frame. Null when no editor host is configured.

scheduledFor.description: Set when the deck is held until the owner's allowance frees up

maxAttempts.description: Attempts before the deck is given up on

progressPhase.description: Which stage of generation the deck is in

progressTotal.description: The generator's own slide total, which may differ from slideCount

limit.description: Decks per rolling 24h, or null for no limit (administrators).

resetsAt.description: When the oldest slot in the window frees

nextSlotAt.description: When a deck submitted now would start. Null while under quota.

prompt.description: What the deck should be about
prompt.example: The causes and consequences of the 1997 Asian financial crisis

webSearch.description: Let the generator search the web

title.description: Display title, used for the heading, the library card and the download filename

shareToken.description: Append to the deck share URL. Treat it as a credential.

formats.description: Only the formats that exist; a failed preview render leaves no pdf.
